definition: of little value or significance
example: The dispute was picayune and pointless.

definition: a vain or conceited person
example: He was a popinjay of fashion.

definition: the anticipation of possible objections in order to forestall them
example: The speech was prolepsis at its finest.

definition: a figure of speech in which an absent or imaginary person is represented as speaking
example: The poem used prosopopoeia effectively.

definition: an extinct horse-like zebra
example: The quagga was hunted to extinction.

definition: the inherent nature or essence of someone or something
example: She pondered the quiddity of art.

definition: unattractive and objectionable
example: His rebarbative manner turned people off.

definition: slow and gloomy
example: His saturnine look worried us.

definition: a person who pretends to be knowledgeable in a subject
example: He was a sciolist on many topics.

definition: pretentious or superficial knowledge
example: His sciolism was quickly exposed.

definition: making a harsh, shrill, or stridulating noise
example: The stridulous cry of the cicada filled the air.

definition: existing, formed, or taking place under water
example: The subaqueous cable spans the ocean.

definition: an urge to overcome melancholy by dancing
example: The villagers fell into a tarantism.

definition: dark; shadowy or obscure
example: The tenebrous forest frightened us.

definition: relating to or resembling a tortoise
example: He moved with testudinal slowness.

definition: boastful, vainglorious
example: His thrasonical claims fell flat.

definition: howling or wailing
example: The ululant wolves filled the night.

definition: the act of stinging or the resulting sensation
example: The nettles caused urtication on her arm.

definition: a person who is unduly anxious about their health
example: He was a valetudinarian of the first order.

definition: the practice or pursuit of sexual pleasure
example: Venery was a theme of the novel.

definition: resembling a worm in form or movement
example: He made a vermicular motion with his hand.

definition: relating to a fox or foxes; crafty or cunning
example: She wore a vulpine smile.

definition: the sky; the vault of heaven
example: Their cheers reached the welkin.

definition: a person or creature; a being
example: He was a sad wight indeed.

definition: relating to sables
example: She wore a zibeline coat.
